description: SETTING ignorePaths REPLACES THE config:recommended DEFAULTS. config:recommended pulls in :ignoreModulesAndTests, whose ignorePaths cover node_modules, bower_components, vendor, and assorted test/fixture directories. Declaring this key overrides that list wholesale rather than adding to it. THE DEFAULTS ARE NOT RE-ADDED, AND THAT IS THE DECISION RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT: the npm manager arrived on 2026-09-04 and is scoped by managerFilePatterns to homelab/health/mcp/package.json alone, so it scans no vendored tree, and node_modules/ is in .gitignore, which stops the one live case - a local npm install committed by accident - one step earlier than an ignorePaths entry would. Re-adding the defaults would only filter what git never tracks. Revisit if a manager is ever enabled unscoped.

legacy-microk8s/** and no_longer_used/** currently match NOTHING. Both managerFilePatterns are anchored to ^homelab/ and ^vps/, so neither frozen tree is scanned in the first place. They are listed as defence in depth against a future pattern that is not anchored, not as active exclusions. **/secrets/** is the opposite and is the one genuinely active entry of the three: the homelab pattern does match homelab/secrets/*.yaml, and this excludes it. Harmless either way, since those files hold only ${VAR} placeholders and name no image, but the exclusion is real rather than defensive.

REBASE EVERY OPEN PULL REQUEST WHEN master MOVES. The master branch ruleset requires the checks `changes`, `lint` and `build`, which exist only on a pull request head the workflow has actually run on, so a pull request opened before the workflow existed - or left behind while master moved - can never merge until Renovate pushes a new head; Renovate's default rebaseWhen: auto only rebases on conflict, which is not enough.

DO NOT SET suppressNotifications: ["dependencyLookupWarnings"]. homelab/ops/scripts/update-watch.py reads the dependency-lookup warning block off the dependency dashboard issue, and that suppression deletes it from the body.

packageRules.description: Keel owns floating controllers; Jobs and CronJobs pull floating tags at each run. Never add digests to these runtime images.
Floating channels are updated by Keel or fresh Job pulls, not Renovate; PostgreSQL remains within its selected major.
This toolbox has no floating tag; Renovate proposes its version and digest updates.

MCP build inputs automerge after image checks and the three-day routine stability wait; advisory PRs have no wait. Daily lock maintenance refreshes transitive packages; its missing timestamp must not leave the check pending.

Reviewer routine inputs wait seven days; daily lock maintenance relies on uv's seven-day exclude-newer floor instead of a release timestamp. Advisory PRs bypass Renovate's wait, but uv still enforces its floor. Enable automerge only after sandbox-changes and sandbox-build are required and the operator accepts the test assessment; keep it off until both conditions hold.
The sandbox base supplies Python; propose it separately so an interpreter change cannot block routine tool updates. Automerge inherits the reviewer-image gate.
Lock maintenance has no release timestamp. Keep the routine cooldown passed to npm or enforced by uv, but do not leave Renovate's stability check pending forever.

Python interpreter minor and major steps are breaking upgrades. Disable and ungroup only those update types across managers: requires-python uses PEP 440 ranges that Renovate cannot safely reclassify. Patch releases within one Python minor follow the ordinary update rules; PyPI package updates are unaffected.
